verdict: TSMC's revenue rose 35% to NT$1,134.1B ($35.9B) on relentless AI-chip demand — and with a 66.2% gross margin, it kept NT$572.5B ($18.1B) as profit, up 58% in a year.

segments.name: High-performance computing
segments.note: Chips for AI data centers and servers — now about three-fifths of everything TSMC sells.

segments.name: Internet of Things
segments.note: Chips for connected devices of every kind.

segments.name: Digital consumer electronics
segments.note: Chips for TVs, game consoles and gadgets.

segments.name: Others
segments.note: Everything else, including older-node specialty work.

opex.name: Operating expenses
opex.note: Research, engineering and running the business side of the fabs — shown as one line, net of other operating income.

otherDetail: Non-operating items of NT$28.8B (about $0.9B) — mostly interest income of NT$28.9B earned on TSMC's cash pile, plus currency gains, partly offset by finance costs and other losses.
footerNote: TSMC reports in New Taiwan dollars (revenue NT$1,134.1B; net income NT$572.5B). Dollar figures are converted at the quarter's average rate of NT$31.59 per US$1 — implied by TSMC's own stated US-dollar revenue of $35.90B. Operating expenses are shown as one line, net of about NT$1.7B of other operating income, because the earnings release does not split them out. The tax line is set so the flow lands on net income attributable to TSMC shareholders.
follow100Note: For every $100 TSMC took in, $50.48 survived as profit. AI data-center chips (high-performance computing) supplied $61.26 of the $100 — and advanced nodes (7-nanometer and below) made up 74% of wafer revenue.

takeaways.title: AI chips run the show
takeaways.text: High-performance computing — mostly AI accelerators — was 61% of revenue, and 3-nanometer plus 5-nanometer chips together were 61% of wafer revenue. Leading-edge demand is the whole story.

takeaways.title: Margins at record levels
takeaways.text: Gross margin reached 66.2% and net margin 50.5% — TSMC charges premium prices for capacity nobody else can supply, and more than half of revenue now lands as profit.

takeaways.title: Guidance points higher
takeaways.text: For Q2 2026 TSMC guided revenue of $39.0–40.2B with gross margin of 65.5–67.5% — another step up, on continued leading-edge demand.
